physical_rationale: The existing interpolator already separates weighted log magnitude from onset-aligned phase/delay. Use globally supported canonical mesh donors for log magnitude only, with the existing full phase and onset delay policy retained uniformly at every frequency; no per-bin/direction learned choice. This targets donor geometry while preserving baseline phase behavior, not a full phase-quality solution.
quality_guards: max and RMS band ILD, max and RMS wrapped IPD <= frozen baseline in each partition +1e-6 numerical tolerance, no null/quiet-bin exclusions
phase_guard: maximum wrapped phase difference per ear versus existing interpolator <=1e-6 rad at every retained FFT bin
time_guards: per partition max and RMS of per-ear pre-measured-10%-peak-onset energy fractions and energy fractions beyond measured512-sample support <= baseline +1e-6; inverse uses production real DC/Nyquist convention, complete1024 samples retained
geometry_guards: exact all710 nodes complexDFT<=2e-5; independent cone weight<=2e-6; nonnegative unit-sum constant fields; canonical fan magnitude continuity<=2e-5 for edge/diagonal angular step<=1e-7 radians; explicit coverage and multi-radius fallback
limitations: Retained phase policy may retain pre-existing directional discontinuities and measured phase errors. No full-sphere below measured elevation, listener, audibility or performance acceptance claims.
